scope: Simulation gait-screening criteria; provisional actuator models, not physical accuracy or safety qualification. Do not relax failed bounds.

search.objective: Net travel speed among complete non-fallen trials; finalists must additionally meet tracking, reference, and geometry gates.

limitations: Reference envelope is authored, not a measured limit.
Sampled clearance is not continuous collision proof.
No physical-unit mapping or calibrated battery/current model.
Every candidate executes the bounded controller inside full Rust simulation; no post hoc filtering of accepted results.
